hints.title: Unique Value Grouping
hints.text: Because chosen cells must have strictly distinct values, group row occurrences by cell value and process values in descending order.

hints.title: Row Bitmask Formulation
hints.text: With at most 10 rows, a 10-bit integer completely represents which rows have contributed a cell so far.

hints.title: State Progression
hints.text: For each distinct value, either skip it or assign it to an unoccupied row in the current row mask, updating dp[mask | (1 << r)].

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: V: number of unique values in grid (<= 100)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force cell picking yields combinatorial explosion.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses bitmask dynamic programming over row constraints while iterating unique values.
